propositions: Cloud ADF encode currently emits plain-text paragraphs instead of structured ADF, causing Markdown syntax to appear literally in Jira Cloud
DC wiki codec is identity, so Markdown headings, lists, checklists, code blocks and emphasis render as literal source text instead of native wiki markup
Jira-authored rich constructs (panels, mentions, dates) get corrupted or lost when synced back through rebar reconciler
Round-trip Markdown↔ADF conversion must reach idempotent fixed points without echo loops or content erosion across both Cloud and DC platforms
Two-way sync requires origin-gated echo safety using baselines and change-gated rich_sha to prevent concurrent-edit data loss and preserve Jira-native constructs
DC wiki rendering must degrade gracefully on missing pandoc, timeout, or pathological input without losing content
